svg.title: Rectified flow: reflow endpoint coupling
svg.desc: Curved paths of a previous transport supply endpoint pairs; reflow uses straight-line interpolation targets on the right. Dots share a uniform illustrative time parameter: cubic Bezier coordinates on the left and linear interpolation on the right. The curves are hand-specified, not a numerical ODE solve.
svg.text: Reflow uses endpoints from a learned transport
Shared illustrative t: 0 → 1 · Static view t = 0.5
